verdict.rationale: Supabase is a backend/database platform, not an agentic assistant that itself consumes external tools via MCP; the evidence shows the reverse relationship (Supabase exposes its own MCP server so other AI assistants can plug into Supabase, not that Supabase plugs into other MCP servers to use their tools). This story's axis—being an MCP client that ingests third-party MCP servers—doesn't fit Supabase's product category.
